components.name: Primary Navigation Pill
components.description: Active top-level route chip used in the sticky masthead.
components.css: .ds-nav-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:38px; padding:0 14px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid rgba(22,38,31,0.08); text-decoration:none; font-family:"Manrope","Segoe UI",sans-serif; font-size:0.86rem; font-weight:700; line-height:1.2; letter-spacing:0.04em; transition:background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-pill:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #214f3f); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-nav-pill-active { background:var(--accent, #214f3f); color:#ffffff; } .ds-nav-pill-active:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Secondary Navigation Pill
components.description: Inactive route pill resting on the warm masthead surface.
components.css: .ds-nav-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:38px; padding:0 14px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid rgba(22,38,31,0.08); text-decoration:none; font-family:"Manrope","Segoe UI",sans-serif; font-size:0.86rem; font-weight:700; line-height:1.2; letter-spacing:0.04em; transition:background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-pill:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #214f3f); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-nav-pill-default { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.72); color:var(--ink, #16261f); } .ds-nav-pill-default:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.86); transform:translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact civic marker for mode and generation status.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:38px; padding:0 14px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--accent, #214f3f); color:#f6f4ef; box-shadow:0 18px 54px rgba(18,38,29,0.08); font-family:"Manrope","Segoe UI",sans-serif; font-size:0.86rem; font-weight:700; line-height:1.2; letter-spacing:0.04em; }

components.css: .ds-card { background:var(--panel-strong, #fff9eef5); color:var(--ink, #16261f); border:1px solid rgba(22,38,31,0.09); border-radius:24px; padding:18px; box-shadow:0 18px 54px rgba(18,38,29,0.08); font-family:"Manrope","Segoe UI",sans-serif; transition:transform 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-card h3 { margin:12px 0 8px; font-size:1.05rem; line-height:1.2; font-weight:700; } .ds-card p { margin:0; color:var(--muted, #4f645a); font-size:0.96rem; line-height:1.5; } .ds-level { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:999px; color:#ffffff; font-size:0.86rem; font-weight:700; line-height:1.2; }

components.name: Source Info Button

narrative.overview: This design system frames the dashboard as a calm civic reading surface for live flood attention rather than a command center or a static government portal. Warm parchment neutrals, deep green ink, and serif-led framing make the interface public-facing and humane, while restrained tonal layering keeps the operational content readable on mobile and under uncertainty. The system rejects generic SaaS chrome, alarmist crisis aesthetics, and update-feed styling in favor of trust, clarity, and measured urgency.
keyCharacteristics: Serif framing with highly legible sans interface text
Status color reserved for actual level semantics

rules.name: The Status-Only Heat Rule
rules.body: Amber, orange, and red belong to operational level semantics first. They should not become general decorative accents.

rules.name: The Warm Utility Rule
rules.body: Core surfaces stay warm and paper-tinted. Avoid pure white, pure black, or cold enterprise neutrals.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif type frames public meaning, sans type carries the working interface.

rules.name: The Layer-First Rule
rules.body: If tonal contrast can create separation, use it before increasing shadow depth.

dos: Do preserve the warm neutral field using #efe8d8, #f8f5ef, and #d9e2d4.
Do use #214f3f as the main civic accent for navigation, chips, and links.
Do pair color with explicit level text for all risk communication.
Do keep interactions quiet, around 180ms, using transform, opacity, and tonal changes.
Do maintain the rounded surface rhythm of 28px panels, 24px cards, and 999px pills.
donts: Don't make it feel like a government PDF portal.
Don't make it feel like a generic SaaS dashboard.
Don't make it feel like an alarmist disaster app.
Don't make it feel like a newsfeed clone.
Don't replace tonal layering with decorative glassmorphism everywhere.
Don't use pure black, pure white, or cold un-tinted neutrals that break the paper-field character.
